gbm_population_evidence.quote: Malignant Tumor; Advanced Solid Tumor; Glioblastoma Multiforme; Metastatic Cancer
Expansion cohort 1: Patients affected by GBM.

candidate_evidence.quote: The PhAST Trial is an adaptive first-in-human clinical trial of the acetylglucosaminyltransferase V inhibitor PhOx430 in patients with advanced solid tumours

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Radiologically documented progressive disease after at least one prior treatment for metastatic/advanced disease.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: to characterize the pharmacodynamics (PD) effect of PhOx430 on blood, urine and tumour samples collected before and after treatment

role_evidence.quote: A standard 3 + 3 design will be followed. PhOx430 will be administered orally twice a day (bid), at a 12-hour interval, continuously in cycles of 21 days.

coder_notes: PhOx430 is registered twice (dose-escalation steps 1-2 and step 3) as the same drug; listed once. GBM is an expansion cohort (cohort 1) in a solid-tumour first-in-human trial. Only plasma PK is planned; PD in tumour samples before and after treatment is planned (exploratory).
